lines.caption: This is a tour of pull request 152, which stops the status bar from re-reading every file on each cursor move.
lines.say: This is a tour of pull request one fifty-two, which stops the status bar from re-reading every file on each cursor move.

lines.caption: It has three parts: what this PR adds, how it was built and verified, and what comes later.
Part 1. What this PR adds.
Total, Free space and the selection now come from file data Thunar already holds, and the old background job is gone.
The view watches its folder for files added, removed or changed, such as a file that grows.
Any such change drops the cached Total, which is counted again on the next status bar update.
Free space is asked without blocking when the folder opens, and again at most every two seconds while files change.
When the cursor moves, the selection text is counted from memory, for one file or several.
Total comes from the cache, and a search adds up its sizes only when its results change.
The status bar shows the selection on the left, and Total and Free space on the right, as before.
The background job that re-read every file on each selection change is removed.
Since 74, each cursor move asked the disk about every file in the folder, which is slow on big folders and network shares.
lines.say: Since seventy-four, each cursor move asked the disk about every file in the folder, which is slow on big folders and network shares.

lines.caption: Thunar already holds each file's size and flags in memory, so counting needs no disk, and only after the files change.
Steps 1 and 2: the folder's change signals clear the cached Total and search size; a signal with no files is ignored.
Step 3: free space reuses the async lookup that 74 added for search, now for every folder.
lines.say: Step 3: free space reuses the async lookup that seventy-four added for search, now for every folder.

lines.caption: Step 4: several selected files are counted in memory, last-modified date included, with no disk reads.
Step 5: the folder is counted again only without a cached Total, or after a setting changes; a search when a file result changes.
Step 6: the layout and words of the status bar stay the same.
With nothing, one file or several selected, a cursor move used to read the whole folder. Now it reads nothing.
While searching, results are added up only when they change, not on every update.
The counting helper now counts Thunar's own file objects, and hidden still means hidden or backup.
The view keeps one cache: the Total text and its settings, the search size and the free space.
The old status bar job and its callbacks are deleted, so there is one path, not two.
The PR changes six files in the thunar folder, adds the test script, and this page with its narration.
To undo it, revert the merge commit; the status bar text is the same either way.
Part 2. How it was built and verified.
The local checks ran in the cloud container, then CI built and tested the PR, both before the latest review fixes.
It was checked against the status bar from 74 and its test, and reuses that PR's free space lookup.
lines.say: It was checked against the status bar from seventy-four and its test, and reuses that PR's free space lookup.

lines.caption: The package built in the cloud container, with no new compiler warnings.
All three tests passed locally, including test 74, unchanged.
lines.say: All three tests passed locally, including test seventy-four, unchanged.

lines.say: During twenty cursor moves, the trace saw no stat calls on the two thousand forty-two files, though it saw six thousand eight hundred thirty-five during the whole run.

lines.caption: The same test showed Total following a file that grew, and the right size for a search.
CI run 45793496727 then built the package from the PR's head commit.
